svg.title: Supplier Account Ranges Practitioners Report
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-supplier-account-ranges; chapter number: 2; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Supplier Account Ranges Practitioners Report; subtitle: Acceptance, markup, margin floor, quote close rate and MAP compliance; unit: percent; caption: Ecommerce Paradise reports 30-50% acceptance when applying to 10-20 brands at once, while Daniel Boufford pegs distributor markups at 20-50% over brand direct.; assumptions note: No practitioner gave a midpoint, so each typical marker sits at the low end of the quoted range. The quote close rate restates one sale per twenty quotes as a percentage.; note: Sources: Ecommerce Paradise [hHXf1_WdANY @ 00:17:39; 00:09:24], Daniel Boufford [jYFh4ucNZuw @ 00:00:15], Build Assets Online [ocjVuvj0QJg @ 00:04:14], built with ali [pbk_t9e4Xpo @ 00:21:56].; bars: label: Acceptance on batch applications; min: 30; max: 50; typical: 30; display: 30-50% when applying to 10-20 brands; label: Distributor markup over brand direct; min: 20; max: 50; typical: 20; display: 20-50% markup; label: Supplier margin walk-away line; min: 10; max: 15; typical: 10; display: Reject suppliers under 10-15% margin; label: Sale rate on high-ticket quotes; min: 5; max: 5; typical: 5; display: About one sale per twenty quotes; label: MAP compliance ceiling; min: 90; max: 90; typical: 90; display: About 90% compliance at best

text.title: Assumptions: No practitioner gave a midpoint, so each typical marker sits at the low end of the quoted range. The quote close rate restates one sale per twenty quotes as a percentage.
